root.name: Caro-Kann Defense: Classical Variation
root.moves: 1. e4 c6 2. d4 d5 3. Nd2 dxe4 4. Nxe4 Bf5

overview: Black takes on e4 and develops the light bishop outside the pawn chain before playing ...e6. The main line is 5.Ng3 Bg6 6.h4 h6 7.Nf3 Nd7 8.h5 Bh7 9.Bd3 Bxd3 10.Qxd3, where White has a small space edge and Black has a sound, compact position. White often castles long and attacks the h-pawn, while Black plays ...e6 and ...Ngf6 and aims for ...c5.

white_ideas.idea: Harass the bishop with h4-h5 and gain space on the kingside.
Develop quickly with Nf3, Bd3 and consider queenside castling.

black_ideas.idea: Trade the light bishop and play ...e6 and ...Ngf6 for a compact structure.

typical_structures.structure: White d4 pawn against Black c6-e6 pawns and the d-file half open.

character.notes: Anchor-type Solid. The h4 lines have tactics but Black's position is safe.

gambit.notes: e4 pawn is won back by force.

structure.notes: Asymmetric centre with a half-open d-file.

plan_phrases: good light bishop outside the chain
